decision: Extend existing Power House Dashboard/Activity Status, ScoreMax operations/admin health, and Growth /system/health. Do not create a fourth dashboard.

states.HEALTHY: Last success within contract-specific threshold; no dead letters/quarantine; schema compatible.
states.DELAYED: Queue age or retry count exceeds warning threshold but originating platform remains safe.
states.FAILED: Dead-letter, persistent auth/schema failure, checksum conflict or unavailable peer beyond critical threshold.
states.NOT_CONFIGURED: Credentials/endpoint intentionally absent in a non-integrated environment.

operator_actions: Retry selected dead-letter using original identity
Disable one contract direction without disabling originating product transactions
